description_en: Associates or disassociates protected resources with or from a protection template
description_zh: 绑定或解绑防护资源与防护模板的关系
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-template-resources --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 2291 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTemplateResources

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protection template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to associate, in the format of ["XX1","XX2",...]
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的防护对象，使用["XX1","XX2",……]格式
parameters.name: bind_resources

parameters.help_en: The protected object groups to associate, in the format of ["group1","group2",...]
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的防护对象组，使用["group1","group2",……]格式
parameters.name: bind_resource_groups

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to disassociate, in the format of ["XX1","XX2",...]
parameters.help_zh: 解除绑定的防护对象，使用["XX1","XX2",……]格式
parameters.name: unbind_resources

parameters.help_en: The protected object groups to disassociate, in the format of ["group1","group2",...]
parameters.help_zh: 解除绑定的防护对象组，使用["group1","group2",……]格式
parameters.name: unbind_resource_groups

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. If you do not specify this parameter, a normal request is sent. Valid values:
true: A dry run request is sent. The system checks whether the request meets the execution conditions without performing the specified operation. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code Defense.Control.DryRunOperation is returned.
false: A normal request is sent. The specified operation is performed after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启 DryRun 预检模式。如果不输入该参数，表示发起正常请求。取值：
true：表示发起预检请求，仅检查请求是否满足执行条件，不执行请求指定的操作。预检不通过时返回相应错误码；预检通过时返回错误码Defense.Control.DryRunOperation。
false：表示发起正常请求；检查通过后执行请求指定的操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the protected assets to associate, in the format of ["XX1","XX2",...]
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的防护资产ID，使用["XX1","XX2",……]格式
parameters.name: bind_assets

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the protected assets to disassociate, in the format of ["XX1","XX2",...]
parameters.help_zh: 解除绑定的防护资产ID，使用["XX1","XX2",……]格式
parameters.name: unbind_assets
